# agenco_rbac_policy (Resource)

Manages an RBAC policy granting tool access to a set of roles or permissions. At least one of internal_tool_ids, custom_code_tool_ids or custom_integration_tools is required.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agenco_rbac_policy" "refund_admins" {
  name    = "Only refund admins may issue refunds"
  enabled = true
  type    = "rbac-roles"
  keys    = ["refund-admin", "support-lead"]

  application_ids   = [agenco_application.storefront.id]
  internal_tool_ids = [agenco_tool.refund.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is evaluated. Not returned by the API's read route, so the configured value is kept in state.
- `keys` (Set of String) Role or permission keys granted access to the selected tools.
- `name` (String) Policy name.
- `type` (String) Whether keys are roles or permissions. One of: [rbac-roles rbac-permissions].

### Optional

- `application_ids` (Set of String) Applications the policy applies to. Not returned by the API's read route, so the configured value is kept in state.
- `custom_code_tool_ids` (Set of String) Custom code tool IDs the policy applies to.
- `custom_integration_tools` (Set of String) Connector tool API IDs the policy applies to, formatted {integration_id}_{group}_{action}, for example slack_chat_postMessage.
- `description` (String) Free-text description of what the policy grants.
- `internal_tool_ids` (Set of String) Internal tool IDs the policy applies to. Pass an empty set to apply to all tools.
- `slug` (String) Restrict the policy to one connector instance by slug.
- `tenant_id` (String) Restrict the policy to a single tenant. Omit for a vendor-level policy.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Policy ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import agenco_rbac_policy.refund_admins 77778888-9999-0000-1111-222233334444
```
